text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Sumo wrestler food is all chanko hot
pot, right?
So if I make hot pot, do you
think I should call it
"ma-chanko hot
pot"?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ma-chanko hot pot! Sounds great! What
kind of
hot pot is it though? You have to
tell me!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
First, you put fruit, lemon juice, and
cane sugar in
a pot and let them battle it
out until they blend
together. You'll
know it's done when it looks like
a fox.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Then you take flour, sugar, and chilled
butter and
squeeze it all up like you're
giving your grandpa a
shoulder rub.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Then, let that mingle in the
long-neglected pot
for a bit and send
them all on vacation to a hot
summer
oven until golden brown.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
There you have it. That's ma-chanko hot
pot. It's
a pick-me dish that plays nice
with both custard
and ice cream.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Just like apple crumble—sounds
delicious! I get it.
If it's hot and in a pot,
then that counts as hot pot
cooking! ♪

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Do you think it'd be popular? I wonder if

ma-chanko hot pot would sell well.
